summary: Bicara Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a sub-sublease agreement with Wayfair LLC for approximately 35,090 square feet of office space for its new corporate headquarters at 10 St. James Avenue, Boston. The sublease term begins on the later of October 1, 2026 and execution of landlord consent, with base rent of $105,279 per month payable nine months after commencement, and a security deposit of $210,540. The term ends September 30, 2028. This is a routine operational lease agreement, not a special situation. No deal terms or unusual financial arrangements apply. This is a routine contractual disclosure, not a special situation.
